headline: Semiconductors to Recover Within the Month: TSMC and Sony Draw on Experience – One Week After the Kumamoto Earthquake: Jiji.com
summary: One week after a magnitude 7 earthquake hit Kumamoto Prefecture, Sony and TSMC semiconductor plants that halted operations are gradually resuming work. Mitsubishi Electric is also expected to return to pre-disaster output levels.
why: Sony and TSMC are major chip makers, and Kumamoto hosts key semiconductor production, so plant outages can disrupt global chip supply chains.
